 Synthetic CO2 Room Transmitter - Technical Datasheet

 Supplier model CO2-TX-2K - Revision D

 Product summary
 Synthetic wall-mount nondispersive-infrared CO2 transmitter for building ventilation applications. This
 datasheet is provided as a hardware evidence source; the baseline simulation uses an ideal concentration
 sensor but retains the same measurement range.
    Parameter                       Value
    Measurement principle             NDIR, self-calibrating
   CO2 range                      0 to 2000 ppm
    Accuracy at 25 C                   ±(40 ppm + 3% of reading)
    Resolution                       1 ppm
     Typical response time (T63)         90 s
    Analog output                      0-10 V = 0-2000 ppm
     Digital output                    BACnet MS/TP, CO2 object in ppm
    Supply                          24 VAC/VDC
    Operating temperature             0 to 50 C
   Recommended mounting             1.1 to 1.7 m above finished floor
     Fault indication                     Value flagged invalid on internal diagnostics

 Project integration note
 The physical device reports ppm. ICD-IAQ-03 defines the internal simulation/controller concentration signal
 as trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg, followed by a normalization gain. Therefore a SysML model may
 legitimately represent both a sensor display quantity in ppm and an internal feedback quantity in kg/kg,
 provided the conversion/interface is explicit.
